gaps.why_now: The existing Phase 9 build step is the narrowest honest place to keep runtime atomic64 reviewable, and it now runs the direct `phase9-runtime-atomic64-sample-tests` leg so the bounded sample contract stays first-class beside the survey, module, diff, loader, and shared loader checks.

An atomic64-specific survey gate keeps the lib/atomic64_test.c anchor, the landed sample, module, diff, and shared loader-request surfaces, plus the remaining shared runtime-control blocker, explicit while the pilot surface stays small.
A sample-backed lifecycle starter is the first honest runtime-facing step that can reuse existing atomic helpers without pretending the full module substrate already exists.
A dedicated Phase 9 test file keeps the starter sample reviewable and bounded around lifecycle transitions plus the selftest-facing atomic64 surface, including the newly landed bitwise family.

A narrow differential gate now captures selected atomic64_test.c expectations for arithmetic, bitwise (`or`, `and`, `xor`, and `andnot`), wide-value exchange and cmpxchg behavior, bounded guard paths (`add_unless`, `inc_not_zero`, and `dec_if_positive`), plus selftest-family coverage before any broader runtime substrate work.

A tiny sample-side loader scaffold makes the existing requires_runtime_substrate contract reviewable through explicit entry and exit symbol names, handoff-stage checks, a no-substrate release path, and an atomic64 summary payload that now feeds the shared runtime-loader request surface.

The shared runtime-loader request surface now consumes the atomic64 loader handoff directly through `zigux/kernel/runtime_loader.zig`, keeping allocator posture, staged entry and exit symbols, and atomic64 payload facts machine-checkable before any real runtime execution path exists.

The atomic64 pilot still depends on the broader shared runtime-loader control surface tracked by the runtime loader gap survey: command-name, argv-policy, and environment-derived activation handling are still absent, so the pilot remains pre-execution.

non_goals: a loadable Zigux runtime atomic64 module
true runtime execution or lifecycle parity through a shared loader path
the full lib/atomic64_test.c surface beyond the bounded starter and diff cases
shared runtime-loader command-name, argv-policy, or environment activation controls
